decisions.meetings: There was no customer Meetings route. The meetings and visits for a request come from the saved commercial report read client-side inside that request's Room, not from the request detail, so combining them across requests would be a new multi-read path. The Meetings page lists the person's requests (the same list the Requests page reads, with the same session proof) and opens each where its meetings and visits are. One list of all meetings says Coming soon as plain text.
decisions.search: The board's header search has no backend that answers it under a customer's role, so it is left out (rule 3). Search stays where lists are.
decisions.honesty: Plain text with a Coming soon tag, announced as unavailable (aria-disabled), never a link or a button: Chat on WhatsApp (no owner-configured number exists), Report a Problem, Text Size, Stronger Colours, Less Movement, and Help on WhatsApp in the sidebar. Plan and Billing is a link only where customer billing is on. Company Profile follows the chosen workspace and is Coming soon with none. Mark All Read is real: it uses the existing single-item read call for each unread item, then reads the list again.
decisions.phone: Below 640 px the language and help menus are inside the avatar menu so the header row fits at 320 px; the notifications bell and the compact New Request stay in the row (the bell exists today, dropping it would lose it). At 420 px and narrower New Request is the icon alone with its name kept for assistive technology.
decisions.needsYou: Unread invitations (team, contributor, programme), assigned tasks and quotes sent are Needs You; other unread items are Updates; anything read is Earlier.
decisions.retargetedTests: tests/integration/ux-one-workspace-switcher.test.ts now checks the switcher in the avatar menu (names the current workspace, keeps the section, Manage Workspaces) and that the sidebar and header row carry none; the 16 px chevron check went with the card it described. tests/e2e/verification/revamp-s2/customer-shell.spec.ts replaces the CX PR 1 cases about the left drawer and the account menu at the foot of the bar with the new design, keeping the case ids and every property (keyboard, Escape and focus return, unclipped menus, Listen start and stop, names and addresses); customer-home.spec.ts looks for the one filled action in the sidebar. Nothing was weakened or skipped.
decisions.listen: Listen to This Page in the Help menu uses its own small speech hook rather than editing the shared corner dock; the corner dock is unchanged and is hidden on customer pages because the Help menu replaces it there.
decisions.inboxName: The bell keeps its existing accessible name Inbox (the board labels it Notifications, 2 new). Existing operator tests (v3-saved-commercial-ui GAP-004), the team header and the binding condition that names and test hooks stay reachable all use Inbox; the panel it opens is titled Notifications as on the board. One prop (NotificationsPanel label) changes it if the owner prefers the board's word.
decisions.headerCalls: The customer header makes no calls except its inbox where it is not on an account page: the person's session (for the avatar initials) and the workspaces are read only on the customer account pages, as the sidebar did before. The workspace router is used only in the workspace radios on a workspace page.
decisions.focus: In the grouped panel an item that is read moves from Updates to Earlier and its button is replaced; if that leaves focus on the page, focus returns to the panel title, so Escape still closes the panel and returns to the bell (found by the existing GAP-004 operator test, covered again in customer-shell.spec.ts).
decisions.uxBaseline: /account/meetings has a UX baseline entry of unavailable 6 in tests/ux/ux-baseline.json: the measured 404 on the gate's server (the shells switch is off there), the same as the other switch-gated customer pages.

UX gate: passed.

The dead .brand span rules are not removed here: they go in a follow-up after the brand PR 339 lands.
sensitive: No. No auth, session, role or public-route behaviour changes: the same reads, the same links and the same actions; the new Meetings page reads the same request list under the same session proof.

guardianFixes.notificationSettings: Blocking (S1 Guardian on 1e38390e): Notification Settings pointed at /account/notifications, which answers 404 unless Pulse or the customer area is on. One helper (lib/ux/notification-settings.ts) now answers for both the page and the menu; the flag reaches the header the way billing does (CustomerBarNote, store, avatar items); off, the item is plain text tagged Coming soon. Tests: model (on and off), the helper under each real environment setting, and a browser case that every link in the avatar menu opens.
guardianFixes.phoneTabsTranslated: The phone tabs printed English labels; they now use the sidebar's message keys (labelKey on each tab), and Meetings, a new word with no reviewed translation, is marked lang en. Browser case with a Bangla choice.
guardianFixes.homeCondition: Home is Your Move only with both CORRIDRA_UX_NAV and CORRIDRA_UX_MOVE, exactly as the old list decided (it had become Move alone). Test renders the shell under each combination.
guardianFixes.meetingsGated: The Meetings page answers 404 unless CORRIDRA_UX_SHELLS_V2 is on, like the navigation that leads to it, and says 'Your requests list is not available here yet' where the workspaces or requests modules are off instead of 'no requests'. It is excluded from All tools with a written reason (a link there would lead nowhere without the switch), and its UX baseline is the measured 404 (unavailable 6), like the other switch-gated pages.
guardianFixes.alsoDone: Two of the Guardian's follow-ups, both small: the workspace choices and Manage Workspaces sit together in the identity block (the desktop top level is five), and the bell recounts from the list the panel already reloads after Mark All Read (no extra request; the operator test that pins the request sequence still passes).
guardianFixes.leftForLater: Company Profile as Coming soon when organisation profiles are off; the All Tools group heading 'Missions' on the customer screen.
